title: A Little Fire Inside
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who cannot keep a found thing to himself, and tonight Jeremiah's fire in the bones is exactly that: good news from Heavenly Father that will not stay in, the same way Scout's new song burst out the moment the car door shut.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a true thing you have found is almost impossible to keep to yourself. In Scout's world today: Scout learned a brand new song at preschool and decided to save it as a surprise. He lasted until the car door shut. Then out it came bubbling, all the verses at once, and then again. Just like Jeremiah with the fire in his bones, Scout learned that good news from Heavenly Father wants to be sung.
